name: AC2.2 yes, it is about that request: a note on it and no new request

dynamic_variables.open_requests: R-1042: Trucking at Route 104 Widening, 3 trucks tri-axle dump trucks, needed by Monday, November 2 at 7:00 AM, recorded Saturday, October 31 at 6:45 AM

simulation_scenario: You are Dale, a foreman on the Roster. When the assistant asks what you need, say: "I need a truck at the 104 job Monday at nine." When it asks whether this is about your existing tri-axle dump trucks request, say: "Yeah, that's the one." After it answers, say thanks, goodbye.
success_conditions: Before any read-back or submit, the agent calls find_duplicates with job_id 14 and category Trucking, then asks whether this is about the existing tri-axle dump trucks request from Saturday, October 31 at 6:45 AM, as one question.
After the Foreman says yes, the agent calls add_note once with ref R-1042 and a text that carries the new need in the Foreman's words: a truck, Monday at nine.
The agent never calls submit_requests and does not give a new reference number.
After add_note returns ok, the agent says it was added to the request for the office (R-1042), and does not say anyone has seen it, been told or will act on it.
The agent never says whether trucks or anything else is available, never gives a time when anything will arrive, be done or be decided, and never says the existing request is confirmed.

${tool_create_callback_request}.mock_result: {"error": "The callback request could not be saved."}

${tool_find_duplicates}.mock_result: [{"ref": "R-1042", "job": "Route 104 Widening", "category": "Trucking", "need": "tri-axle dump trucks", "quantity": 3, "unit": "trucks", "needed_by": "Monday, November 2 at 7:00 AM", "recorded_at": "Saturday, October 31 at 6:45 AM"}]
